name: Emergency MEDEVAC Delivery with Escort
summary: Priority medical payload delivery while a second UAV escorts and clears the corridor.
objective: Deliver the {payload_kg} kg medical kit to {drop_zone} inside {deadline_s} s while the escort UAV screens the corridor and reports any obstruction.
brief: A casualty needs the medical kit at {drop_zone} within {deadline_s} s. Fly the carrier on the shortest safe route at {cruise_mps} m/s, keep the escort {escort_sep_m} m ahead on the corridor, and release within {accuracy_m} m of the drop-zone centre from at least {drop_alt_m} m. If the corridor is blocked, the escort must declare the blocking object before the carrier enters it.

actions: both UAVs recover to the nearest landing zone

checkpoints.name: Role separation
checkpoints.metric: escort lead distance and carrier separation
checkpoints.target: escort leads by {escort_sep_m} +/- 20 m; carrier-escort >= 40 m

checkpoints.name: Delivery accuracy
checkpoints.metric: impact distance to {drop_zone} centre and impact speed

checkpoints.name: Obstruction reporting
checkpoints.metric: blocking-object reports from the escort before carrier entry
checkpoints.target: 1 report per blocking object, no carrier entry before the report

checkpoints.name: Recovery
checkpoints.target: both on ground, no hard landing

failure_conditions: carrier enters a corridor section the escort has not cleared
constraints: escort never loses sight of the carrier
grading: global checkpoint pass rate; checkpoint weights sum to 100
